for r in range(15,23): G[r,6]=7;G[r,12]=7
G[19,0:7]=7
for r in range(23,30): G[r,9]=7
marks={(2,21):9,(20,10):2,(21,11):9,(27,15):4,(28,16):9,(29,17):5,(28,28):8,(29,29):2,(29,8):8}
for (r,c),v in marks.items():G[r,c]=v
# flood comps not wall
from collections import deque
vis=np.zeros(G.shape,bool); comps=[]
for r in range(30):
 for c in range(30):
  if G[r,c]!=7 and not vis[r,c]:
   q=deque([(r,c)]);vis[r,c]=1; pts=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();pts.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
     xx,yy=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=xx<30 and 0<=yy<30 and G[xx,yy]!=7 and not vis[xx,yy]:vis[xx,yy]=1;q.append((xx,yy))
   comps.append(pts)
for i,pts in enumerate(sorted(comps,key=lambda p:(min(x for x,y in p),min(y for x,y in p)))):
 rs=[x for x,y in pts];cs=[y for x,y in pts];mk=[(x,y,G[x,y]) for x,y in pts if G[x,y]!=1]
 print(i,len(pts),(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)),mk)
